calls.name: set_controller

args.code:
T0 = None

def control(obs):
    global T0
    t = obs.get('t', 0.0)
    if T0 is None:
        T0 = t
    h = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    hd = -5.0 if (t - T0) < 5.0 else 0.0
    steer = 3.0 * (h - hd)
    steer = max(-30.0, min(30.0, steer))
    return (steer, -0.6, -23.0)

note.text: Early drift is the root problem: the trailer rear crept toward the left rail while hitch-only steering held the angle but ignored where the rear was, so every fix became a costly pinned forward clear-up. Keep the rear well away from the left rail from the very start and act on the camera early, before a rail gets close. Reverse slowly with gentle steering. Forward clear-ups with hard steer swung the front corner into the right rail, so keep those gentle and short and do not repeat the same loop.
